sources.citation: Bahuchet, Serge. 1995. Changements culturels et changements linguistiques dans la forêt d'Afrique centrale. Revue d'ethnolinguistique 7: 9-24.

sources.citation: LePage, Sarah Gloria. 2020. The phonology of Mbati. MA thesis, University of North Dakota (UND Scholarly Commons 3379).
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in
sources.note: Read only for its remarks on Ngando: summarises Bouquiaux & Thomas 1975/1994 (phoneme inventories for Mbati and Ngando; Ngando lacks /b d/, has /ɓ ɗ/); nothing on Ngando stress or tone beyond those references.

sources.citation: Bahuchet, Serge. 2006. Languages of African rainforest 'pygmy' hunter-gatherers: language shifts without cultural admixture. Talk, MPI-EVA Leipzig.

sources.citation: Bahuchet, Serge. 1996. Fragments pour une histoire de la forêt africaine et de son peuplement: les données linguistiques et culturelles. In Hladik et al. (eds), L'alimentation en forêt tropicale. Paris: UNESCO.
sources.note: Only lists ngando among the C10 languages spoken by farmers; nothing on prosody.

sources.citation: Bahuchet, Serge. 1986. Linguistique et histoire des Pygmées de l'ouest du bassin congolais. Sprache und Geschichte in Afrika 7(2): 73-103.
sources.note: Comparative/historical linguistics of Aka vs. its neighbours; states aka, ngando, mbati and pande are related C10 languages; no phonology of Ngando, nothing on tone or stress (text-layer a full-text search for stress/accent ton/tonal/accent finds no relevant hit).

sources.note: Unknown for Ngando: title and second-hand description only. The paper classifies each Central African language surveyed by its number of 'tons ponctuels' (level tones) and 'tons modulés' (contour tones) and maps tone areas (LePage 2020:94 quotes it for Mbati, 1972:121); if Ngando is included it would give Ngando's level/contour tone count in the LACITO analysis that later (Bouquiaux & Thomas 1975) treated Ngando within an 'aire de génération de tons'.
